votes.summary: Round-1 re-ballot after visibility was resolved via the exact file index: I read all 17 listed files (bounded pages for the large JSON contracts) and can now score on evidence, superseding my round-0 abstention which was purely an artifact-readability failure. The artifact is a coherent, internally consistent architecture and execution contract for converging the legacy command/knowledge flows onto the frozen Comet single-controller profile, and it matches the gated decision exactly: implementation authorization only, with runtime acceptance, business-profile enablement, and all external writes/publication still gated. Independently verified: task-dag.json has 39 nodes / 69 work packages, all depends_on edges point backward within the 39 single-node waves, and VERIFY is the sole sink depending on all 38 other nodes; counts 92 original + 12 new = 104 scenarios and 108 retained + 10 repair + 12 new = 130 required checks are consistent across SOURCE-MANIFEST, replan record, handoff, contract, and commands_status; the acceptance_aggregation maps all 104 scenarios (A01-N12) to concrete check IDs; spec.md N01-N12 oracles textually match the V_N01-V_N12 expected fields; bindings.json covers N01-N12. Boundary design is strong and frozen: Comet sole Run/state/dispatch/recovery owner with no second currentPhase, TeamAI distribute-only, pure-evaluate Gate, execute-only Runner/adapter, method skills without dispatch authority, Kp blocking all archive entries and Kt blocking completion, monitor/supervisor outside business authority (drift-lock frozen interfaces lines 115-155, global constraints 157-167, controller_override/closeout_override lines 4072-4073). Security posture for this stage is sound: trusted identity from launcher records not role strings (V_RW_TRUSTED_REVIEW, observer_contract pass_requirements), real OS/container role isolation as a negative gate (V_RW_RUNNER_BUILD, RoleBoundary.v1), secrets only as purpose-bound SecretRef.v1, fail-closed disclosure-intersection publication authorization with unknown≠public (U02/U06, V_U04-U06), quarantine/fence-on-restore (Restore.v1), R10 sole-workspace retention, no production/remote writes without registered grants, credentials_included=false. Fail-closed reliability semantics (UNVERIFIED nonzero, no skip-to-PASS, historical_results_may_close=false everywhere, monotonic invalidation with no byte-restore revival) are consistently expressed. Two non-blocking drift risks remain and are owned by existing DAG tasks: the managed-pilot vs comet-managed-v2 profile token split (R2-001) and the stale pre-convergence IMPLEMENTED/PASS journey_definitions labels (R2-002), both explicitly flagged as planned-not-executed interfaces by the governing contract. I would authorize implementing the frozen converged profile under the recorded existing authorization with the artifact's own verification gates left intact.

APPROVE for implementation scope only. With the coordinator's exact file index I re-read the unchanged artifact (SHA 9784847e...) and independently re-verified it end to end this round: all 15 manifest per-file hashes and 9 in-staged replan hashes match actual bytes; drift-lock's four internal sha256 pins match; the DAG has 39 nodes / 69 unique work packages, is acyclic, has zero dangling references, a single VERIFY sink, and waves that cover every node exactly once in valid topological order with all nodes CURRENT_PROFILE_NOT_VERIFIED; the execution contract has 130 unique checks, all required, all historical_results_may_close=false, all in planned-not-executed states, with every task_ids/implementedBy reference resolving to a real DAG node; scenario coverage is exact and mutually consistent (104 DAG acceptance IDs = 104 spec.md scenarios incl. N01–N12 = 104 case-plan cases all CURRENT_PROFILE_RETEST_REQUIRED with historical_pass_inherits=false = 104 bindings keys = 104-entry aggregation map verified check-for-check). The single-controller boundaries in ADR-0020 and the convergence architecture (no second currentPhase, pure Gate, dispatch-only TeamAI, Runner without business state, Kp blocks archive / Kt blocks completion, fencing on restore, R10 retention, purpose-bound secret references, disclosure-intersection publication, separately gated F10 cross-machine scope) are enforced identically in drift-lock frozen interfaces and the N01–N12 WHEN/THEN oracles. This matches the gated decision exactly: it authorizes implementing the frozen converged profile under existing authorization while runtime acceptance, business-profile enablement, and all external writes/publication stay gated behind the artifact's own VERIFY. The two MINOR findings re-confirmed open (R1-Z1 profile-token split across 95/12/12 commands plus a third token in flow_convergence; R1-Z2 stale pre-convergence IMPLEMENTED labels on three journey_definitions) are forward drift risks inside interfaces explicitly declared 'planned, not executable evidence', are barred from closing anything by historical_results_may_close=false and the all-130-current-PASS completion predicate, and are already owned by P3_1/P3_2 — not blockers. Round-0 visibility dissent (R1-001/CA-001) reflects a round-0 tooling limitation now resolved by the exact file index, not an architecture defect. I would authorize the gated decision now.
APPROVE，仅批准既有授权内实施。重新读取并独立核对后，单主控边界、原DAG、104场景与130检查映射，以及Kp阻断归档、Kt阻断完成、权限和恢复约束均支持该决策。两项命令与历史标签问题可在既有任务中修订，须于VERIFY前闭合；本票不证明运行或发布已通过。
